description: This file contains utility methods for constructing various URL paths and file system paths related to a web store application, including static content paths, download URLs, store URIs, customer section URLs, admin paths, category URLs, and product URLs.

classes.name: FilePathUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate URLs and file paths for various resources in the web store application.

methods.name: buildStaticFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for static content, such as images, based on store code and image name.

methods.name: buildAdminDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Generates the file path for downloading a digital product from the admin interface.

methods.name: buildOrderDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Creates the URL for product download associated with a specific order.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Builds the base URI for a store, based on request or context path.

methods.name: buildCustomerUri
methods.description: Constructs the customer section URL for a store.

methods.name: buildAdminUri
methods.description: Builds the admin panel URL for a store, considering session configurations.

methods.name: buildCategoryUrl
methods.description: Generates URL for a specific category within the store.

methods.name: buildProductUrl
methods.description: Generates URL for a specific product within the store.
